info.name: Partnerize Brands Attribution Commissions CSV Download API

params.name: campaignId
params.description: The ID of the campaign for the commissions

params.name: start_date_time
params.description: Limits list to commissions active at/from this date

params.name: end_date_time
params.description: Limits list to commissions active until this date

params.name: type
params.description: Limits list to commissions of specified types

params.name: status
params.description: Limits list to commissions with specified status

items.docs: Request a CSV for a Commission report which includes all individual items defined for the Campaign. Each item represents a commission type of default, standard, promotional or voucher commission and rates.
